title: Wisconsin state trooper detained by ICE
summary:
Carel Aaron Van Der Merwe was detained as he was waiting to board a flight.
A Wisconsin state trooper has been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement and is facing deportation to South Africa, according to his lawyer.
Van Der Merwe told ICE officers he had a work permit and a pending asylum application.
An ICE database shows Van Der Merwe is currently being held at a detention facility in Juneau, Wisconsin.
“Putting a Wisconsin State Trooper behind bars while his asylum case sits unresolved does not make our communities safer.

title: Houston will limit ICE cooperation in response to Democrats taking power in Texas, mayor says
summary:
HOUSTON (AP) — Houston's mayor on Friday directed police to limit cooperation with federal immigration authorities, signing an order that he called a result of Democrats reclaiming power in Texas for the first time in decades.
Abbott, a Trump ally, has threatened Texas cities over attempts to curtail immigration enforcement.
Houston has been a recurring scene of protests to Trump's immigration crackdown in the wake of one ICE officer fatally shooting a Mexican homebuilder and another striking a man with a car.
Last week, a grand jury in Houston indicted the ICE officer who was inside the vehicle on charges of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.
Ruby Powers, a Houston immigration attorney, said trust won't be restored right away.

title: Migrant Caravan Bets On Democrat Victory To Loosen Trump’s Border Crackdown
summary:
A new migrant caravan is heading toward the United States from Honduras as Democratic gains in Congress are poised to weaken President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown.
“Here in Honduras, we have nothing left,” 47-year-old Jimena Morazán told Latin Times.
Many caravan members believed that a Democratic Congress could weaken Trump’s hardline border enforcement, whether by creating uncertainty at the border or blocking new restrictions, Latin Times reported.
